title: Recitation spreads by being heard

phrase.meaning: recite in the name of your Lord

points.label: What research comes close
points.text: **William Graham** argues the Qur'an was first an **oral scripture**, known by being recited and heard. Muslim tradition places Surah 74 second, where the command turns public: “Arise and warn”.

points.label: One possible reading
points.text: A message that starts as words to recite travels through **voices and memory**. People learn the words before they decide about them, so belief can grow out of hearing rather than come first.

bottom_text: This is one reading, not a consensus. Uri Rubin's view points the other way: iqraʾ as an act of worship, inward before outward.
source_label: Graham (1987) · Al-Muddaththir, place in revelation order
